note.after_visit_summary: You have moderate acne with dark spots from past breakouts. We are starting two treatments: adapalene 0.1% gel to use every other night at first, then nightly, and doxycycline 100 mg twice daily for 3 months. You will also restart a 4% benzoyl peroxide wash each morning. Take doxycycline with food and a full glass of water, stay upright for 30 minutes after, and avoid dairy, calcium, or iron for 2 hours before and after. Use sunscreen SPF 30 or higher every morning and wear a hat when outside, as both medications increase sun sensitivity. If you think you might be pregnant, stop both medications and call us right away. Use white towels to avoid bleaching concerns. Return in 3 months for a check-up. Call sooner if you get a bad sunburn, severe stomach upset, or headaches with vision changes.
